comment: cfgfiles.c cnf_line_SYMBOLS() and vconfig_error_add(). A 262-byte SYMBOLS value with no ':' or '=' fails parsesymbols(), and config_error_add() quotes it; vconfig_error_add() cuts the message to BUFSZ - 1 = 255 bytes before config_erradd() raw-prints it. The raw print drops everything past column 80, so this screen is the same with or without the cut (it matches on 602f66dce too); it is runtime evidence for the error path, and scripts/config-error.test.mjs pins the cut itself. The Tourist then plays a turn. Seed, clock, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
